title: Jira and Confluence read-only mock acceptance contract
completionClaim: Declared read-only API replacement for offline client development; not a complete Jira or Confluence implementation

executionRules.mode: Run acceptance cases against mock services only
executionRules.writesAllowed: Only review-owned mock administration, never product mutations
executionRules.templateSyntax: Replace {{NAME}} using bindings or the current matrix row; never evaluate templates as executable code
executionRules.matrixExpansion: Cartesian product of matrix dimensions; every expanded row is an independent required case

basisValues.live_observed: Anonymized status or response structure directly observed with read-only requests
basisValues.consumer_contract: Required by the consumer; not necessarily observed for every value on a live server
basisValues.synthetic_design: Deliberately specified fake data, failure injection, or mock-only boundary
basisValues.operational_requirement: Reproducibility, isolation, distribution or privacy requirement

executionRules.unknownResult: NOT_RUN, BLOCKED and SKIPPED do not count as PASS
executionRules.privacy: Do not save real organizations, domains, names, account IDs, space keys, issue/page contents, PATs, cookies or raw live responses
executionRules.additionalResponseFields: Allowed unless a case explicitly forbids them; do not require byte equality or real error-message wording
executionRules.timeComparison: Parse timestamps; compare instants, not lexical strings with different UTC offsets
executionRules.stateIsolation: Serialize shared scenario changes; reset each owned service in finally, including on failure

collection.retained: Statuses, field names and types only

observations.request: GET /rest/api/2/myself without PAT or with one invalid synthetic PAT
observations.note: Authentication-filter errors differ from Jira resource errors

observations.request: Six currentUser scope/resolution searches with startAt=0, maxResults=2 and supported fields
Nonempty search and issue-by-key fields projection
observations.note: Null variants and absent priority are consumer/synthetic cases, not claimed as live observations

observations.request: GET /rest/api/user/current without PAT or with one invalid synthetic PAT

observations.note: space/history/version were absent in this expanded response; expansion can replace default expansions

notObserved: Null resolution on a returned unresolved issue

completionGates.passWhen: Every required expanded mock_http case passes on the exact candidate commit and fixture version
The real consumer query/parser/Host/CLI succeeds against mocks by replacing connection settings only; no canned consumer responses or lowered field validation
All fixtures, mappings, logs, screenshots and export files pass anonymization and credential checks
Import/start/read/fault/reset/restart/stop succeeds from the declared bundle with external downloads actually blocked and evidence retained
All gates have reproducible sanitized evidence; no mandatory result is missing, failed, blocked or skipped; initial failed attempts remain recorded

fixtureModel.source: Invented data; not a redacted export of real issues or pages
fixtureModel.materialization: Render seeds into the declared REST schemas. API links use configured base URLs. User names, project IDs and page IDs below are synthetic constants.

issues.summary: Synthetic active assignment with a long title for wrapping and filtering

jira.resolutionRule: Unresolved means resolution is null. Do not infer it from the status label or category.

confluence.pageOrder: Ascending numeric page ID in the frozen fixture
confluence.anonymousPolicy: For user/current, no PAT or invalid PAT returns HTTP 200 with type anonymous and without username/userKey, matching E-C-ANONYMOUS. This does not grant access to protected fixture pages.

assertions: name and key match the synthetic authenticated fixture user
No real identity or token appears in response
Do not force resource-level errorMessages/errors onto this observed authentication-filter response
No protected fixture data or token is returned
Body is an array; each item matches jiraProject
MOCK and EMPTY identifiers are consistent with issue.project when that field is requested
total equals the complete expected set length, not this page length
Fetched keys equal the expected ordered set after walking all pages
Only requested supported fields plus documented mandatory metadata are returned
expand is optional and its absence is not a failure
Each updated value is a parseable timestamp

steps: Use the corresponding J-SEARCH query with maxResults=pageSize and startAt=0
Collect keys and advance startAt by the actual returned issue count until total is reached
Fail if an empty page occurs before reaching total, an offset repeats, or a request budget of total+2 is exceeded
Read once at startAt=total and once beyond total

assertions: Each ordinary page has HTTP 200 and echoed startAt
issues.length <= response.maxResults <= requested pageSize
A documented positive server page cap may be lower than requested
total remains constant in the frozen fixture
All expected keys appear exactly once in updated-descending order
At/beyond total returns HTTP 200 with empty issues and unchanged total

steps: Search with fixtureModel.jira.fieldsProjection for minimal or enrichedFieldsProjection for enriched
Retrieve one returned issue by key using the same fields parameter

assertions: Validate individual issues, not the search envelope, with jiraIssue
Minimal contains summary, status.statusCategory.key, priority and updated
Enriched also exposes fixture owner/reporter/resolution and dates
Search and detail agree for overlapping fields
Additional unrequested fields cannot be assumed by the client

steps: Read the reported/unresolved query with enriched fields
Locate MOCK-7

assertions: assignee is null, priority is null and resolution is null
The issue remains a reported result without being assigned to the current user
Client renders missing priority without crashing

query.jql: project = EMPTY ORDER BY key ASC

assertions: Empty results are success, not authentication or response failure
Both identifiers resolve to MOCK-1
Following the search issue.self with valid fake PAT returns the same issue identity
Numeric alias is a consumer/synthetic contract; live collection used issue-by-key
No issue data is returned
Message text is synthetic; do not copy private server text
Product-shaped missing-resource error differs from a mock unsupported-request marker
username/userKey match the synthetic authenticated fixture identity
HTTP 200 alone must not be interpreted as authenticated
An optional strict-PAT profile returning 401 does not pass this live-observed parity case
Other-product-token behavior is a synthetic isolation extension

steps: GET /rest/api/space?start=0&limit=pageSize with valid fake PAT
Follow _links.next until absent; validate all spaces with confluenceSpace

assertions: All synthetic spaces are visited exactly once
size equals results.length, not the collection total
size <= response.limit <= requested limit
A positive documented server page cap is allowed
No cycles and no more than fixture space count+2 requests

steps: GET /rest/api/space/~mock.user-a or /rest/api/space/%7Emock.user-a with valid fake PAT

assertions: Do not apply a global-space uppercase-only rule to personal spaces
The key matches the synthetic user's personal space; no real user key is used

steps: GET /rest/api/space/{encoded spaceKey}/content/page?start=0&limit=pageSize with valid fake PAT
Walk _links.next; follow each page self link
Where prev exists, follow it and verify the preceding page
Read at and beyond the fixture page count

assertions: All and only pages of the selected space appear once
Each item matches confluencePage and matches its detail identity/title
size equals current results length and is not treated as total
No next at the last or empty page; links preserve the chosen limit and context
No cycle or request count beyond fixture page count+2
At/beyond the fixture count returns empty results without invented next links
Default metadata refers to the same synthetic space, user and page version
Expanded and default responses retain the same id/type/status/title
Do not require default space/history/version to remain when only body.storage is explicitly expanded
A client must not depend on unrequested metadata expansions
Return explicitly requested supported expansions consistently
This expansion combination was not live-probed and must not be labelled live-observed
No protected page fields occur in the error
data is an optional additional field, not a copied private payload

steps: Repeat one supported query with reordered parameters and equivalent percent encoding
For Jira JQL repeat with percent-20 and plus space encoding
Test duplicate and unknown parameters against the declared unsupported-request policy

assertions: Equivalent supported requests return the same identities/order
Repeated or unsupported parameters do not silently change the intended query
Mock-specific refusal is explicitly documented, not claimed as universal live product behavior

steps: Start a review-owned service with the chosen validated context and a nonconflicting port
Run the product's representative identity/list/detail flow using only the new Base URL and fake PAT
Follow supported API self/next/prev links
Repeat with localhost and 127.0.0.1

assertions: Same client code works without a mock-only branch/header
Supported API links remain within the configured origin/context
No live domain is contacted
Browser-only and metadata links are either implemented or explicitly out of scope
The same path without a configured nonempty context is not silently accepted

setup: Select the matching review-owned WireMock error scenario through its local administration API
steps: Read a supported protected resource with valid fake PAT
Read the same resource with missing and invalid fake PAT
Confirm the other product remains in its normal state

assertions: Valid-PAT request returns the selected HTTP status and JSON product error schema
Jira uses jiraResourceError and Confluence uses confluenceError for injected resource errors
Protected reads never return issue/page contents when authentication fails
Confluence user/current retains its separately declared anonymous-identity contract
Unsupported-request markers are distinct from resource errors

cleanup: Reset only the review-owned service in finally and verify its ordinary read succeeds

setup: Install an isolated, temporary WireMock stub for the selected fault; use no live proxy or recording mode

assertions: delay: configured fixed delay and elapsed monotonic time are recorded; investigate the earlier 1500ms/1495.6ms discrepancy without silently weakening the contract
timeout: use a declared delay exceeding a declared client timeout; do not confuse a short delay with a timeout test
malformed_json: consumer returns a controlled response error, never successful empty data
http_redirect: a request journal proves no second credentialed request is sent to the redirect destination
No raw upstream error or token is displayed or logged
Every request is bounded; clean up stubs and reset scenarios in finally

steps: Try an undeclared endpoint, method and JQL/expansion
Attempt a product POST/PUT/DELETE only against the review-owned mock

assertions: Requests fail with an explicit unsupported marker, never arbitrary success
The marker is documented as mock behavior, not a live-product response
Product fixture data is unchanged
Previously declared valid client requests remain valid

steps: Build the real consumer from the candidate commit
Configure only mock Base URL and fake PAT; real-token environment and credential files are absent
Run its query/parser through real HTTP, then the Host API and thin CLI
Compare keys and totals with the fixture oracle
Open the ordinary dashboard and select the corresponding scope/resolution

assertions: No response interception or canned consumer data bypasses the HTTP server
No weaker field validation, mock-only query rewrite, or production fallback is used
Host and CLI preserve query selection and return the same complete ordered issue set
UI can render statuses and null priority, filter locally and refresh
Switching query selection clears stale rows; empty/error/loading states stay distinct
No network request reaches a live domain

steps: Run one reader implementation against mock identity, space listing, personal-space page listing and storage content
Use Base URL and fake PAT only
Repeat with no PAT and invalid PAT for user/current

assertions: The reader requires type known and identity fields for authenticated status
HTTP 200 anonymous is never authenticated success
Pagination follows the supported links without treating size as total
A reader needing metadata requests expansions explicitly
A named standalone adapter test is allowed if no production Confluence plugin exists; report that scope accurately

steps: Inspect source fixtures, mappings, exported images/configs, logs, screenshots and reports using a private local denylist without printing its values
Verify fake PATs are used and actual credential files are neither mounted nor bundled

assertions: All user/domain/content values are explicitly synthetic or reserved example.invalid values
No real identity, organization, domain, account/space key, issue/page content or credential survives
Runtime response links use the configured local origin
Existing mandatory third-party license notices are preserved

steps: Verify the declared bundle checksum list and source commit/fixture version
Use a review-owned isolated image store and predeclared runtimes
Block external registry/package downloads and demonstrate the block with synthetic probes
Import the pinned image archive without relying on an existing image cache
Start services, run representative identity/search/pagination/storage/error/reset cases
Stop and restart, verify initial fixtures and scenario state, then remove only owned resources

assertions: No package install or image pull is required during offline execution
Image ID/digest, architecture, tool versions, commands and exit codes are recorded
Unsupported, fault and authentication behavior remain available offline
Existing unrelated services, images and network configuration are not destroyed
A --pull never run on a warm developer cache alone is insufficient evidence

steps: Execute representative reads twice without mutation
Select a mock failure, reset it and repeat
Restart review-owned services and repeat the reads

assertions: Fixture identities, membership and ordering remain identical
No cross-product scenario leakage occurs
Temporary faults and anonymous responses do not corrupt authenticated reads
A failed run is recorded before any successful retry; retries cannot erase failure evidence

completion.reason: Specification authored; no mock acceptance cases have been executed under this contract

excludedFromCompletion: SSO, corporate DNS, proxies or private certificates
Product writes, Markdown upload, attachments and comments
AI dashboard control or arbitrary user lookup
optionalFutureCases: Explicit synthetic-user assignment queries without a general JQL engine
Created/resolved timestamps and history for declared analytics
Keep-alive authentication isolation before claiming connection-pool support
